guide.starrail_sim.path.rank_rule: When practice reaches the current target, a breakthrough trial starts automatically. During the trial, complete two objectives that match the path theme; completing both raises the path by one rank. A timeout resets only the current trial objectives and does not erase accumulated practice. After Rank 7, no new breakthrough trial starts: every 120 Pinnacle practice grants another +5% Attack Damage, up to 10 times (+50% total).

guide.starrail_sim.help.title: Path System Guide
guide.starrail_sim.help.open_current: Press P to open the character attributes screen.
guide.starrail_sim.help.path: Selecting a Path does not place a ruin until you click Confirm Path Search. Travel to the displayed anchor, open its chest, and use the matching Trial Token to start that Path's initial trial. Each player can have only one pending ruin clue at a time.
guide.starrail_sim.help.practice: Path-themed actions grant practice. Current practice and its target are shown on the Paths screen. After the Path Pinnacle, practice continues: every 120 points become one +5% Attack Damage milestone, up to 10 milestones.
guide.starrail_sim.help.trial: The matching ruin Trial Token starts the initial trial; completing both objectives enters the Path automatically. Afterward, reaching a practice target automatically starts a rank-up trial, which also ranks up automatically when both objectives are complete.
guide.starrail_sim.help.progress: The ruin anchor stays visible in the lower-left messages and on the Path Search screen. You cannot seek another ruin while a clue is pending. If no site meets the 400-block horizontal spacing, move farther away and retry. The Path Guide explains each trial objective.
guide.starrail_sim.help.rollback: Resetting a path removes its current effects, but keeps its unlocked rank, practice progress, and completed Pinnacle bonus milestones.
guide.starrail_sim.path.preservation.cor: Practice Preservation through blocking and enduring damage, focusing on defense and survival.
guide.starrail_sim.path.preservation.goa: Block 3 attacks and survive after taking 5 hostile damage.
guide.starrail_sim.path.preservation.pra: Block attacks, take hostile damage, and stay alive.
guide.starrail_sim.path.preservation.tip: From R2, gain a shield every 10 seconds; yellow hearts can stack up to 2.5 times your current Armor. From R4, successfully block hostile mob attacks with your shield to build Guard. Ordinary hits, player attacks, and failed blocks do not count. Guard stacks to 3 and expires if you do not block again for 8 seconds. Barrier has a 6-second cooldown.
guide.starrail_sim.path.preservation.mec:
R2 Shield: every 10 seconds, gain Absorption equal to 100% of current Armor (yellow hearts), stacking up to 250% of current Armor.
R4 Guard: each successful block of a hostile mob grants 1 stack, up to 3; each block refreshes an 8-second timer.
R5 Barrier: at 3 stacks, when ready, gain Resistance II for 10 seconds; 6-second cooldown.
R6 Countershock: every successful block during Barrier reflects damage equal to 20% of current Armor.
R7 Upgrade: reflected damage becomes 50% of current Armor; Barrier grants Resistance III for 15 seconds.
guide.starrail_sim.path.destruction.core: Fight while endangered or at low health, turning damage taken into destructive power.
guide.starrail_sim.path.destruction.goal: Defeat 3 hostile mobs below 50% health and take 10 damage.
guide.starrail_sim.path.destruction.prac: Defeat enemies or take damage while at low health.
guide.starrail_sim.path.destruction.tips: Destruction rewards fighting while endangered. Defeating enemies or taking damage at low health grants practice; a flawless fight is not the only way to progress. Higher-rank mechanics turn damage taken into Wrath and Burning Soul, but watch your health so you do not fall before the bonuses activate.
guide.starrail_sim.path.destruction.mech:
R4 Blood Battle: at 50% health or less, melee or ranged hits on hostile mobs deal +10%; no cooldown.
R5 Wrath: hostile damage taken at/below 50% health, or damage that drops you below it, builds up to 3 stacks; stacks last 8 seconds.
R6 Burning Soul: at 3 stacks, gain +35% damage on your next hit for 8 seconds.
R7 Desperation: at 25% health or less, gain +50% next-hit damage and Resistance for 3 seconds; 30-second cooldown.
guide.starrail_sim.path.hunt.core: Focus on defeating enemies and maintaining a hunting streak, emphasizing single-target damage and critical hits.
guide.starrail_sim.path.hunt.goals: Defeat 5 hostile mobs and complete 2 hunting streaks.
guide.starrail_sim.path.hunt.practice: Hunt Intent stacks on hostile mob kills; melee and your own projectile kills count. A hit without a kill grants no Intent.
guide.starrail_sim.path.hunt.tips: Kills advance the hunting streak. Hunt Intent stacks up to 3 times, and the rhythm is lost after 8 seconds without another kill. From Rank 5, the next attack while Intent is active gains Pursuit Strike; Rank 6 critical hits can maintain Intent; Rank 7 Reverse Pursuit has its own cooldown.
guide.starrail_sim.path.hunt.mechanics:
R4 Hunt Intent: each hostile mob kill grants 1 stack, up to 3; stacks expire after 8 seconds without another kill.
R5 Pursuit Strike: at 3 stacks, your next hit consumes them and deals ×1.25 damage.
R6 upgrade: critical hits refresh the 8-second timer.
R7 Reverse Pursuit: a max-stack hit deals ×1.5 damage, then starts a 15-second cooldown. Stacks still build during cooldown, but Reverse Pursuit will not trigger.
guide.starrail_sim.path.erudition.core: Practice Erudition through multi-target hits, chain damage, and area combat.
guide.starrail_sim.path.erudition.goals: Complete 1 multi-target hit, then complete 3 multi-target hits within 30 seconds.
guide.starrail_sim.path.erudition.practi: One melee or ranged attack must damage at least 2 hostile mobs to grant practice; hitting the same mob repeatedly is not a multi-target hit.
guide.starrail_sim.path.erudition.tips: Erudition requires one attack to hit at least 2 enemies. Area attacks, piercing attacks, and controlled grouping make this easier; repeatedly hitting one enemy does not advance multi-target practice. At higher ranks, multi-target hits build Analysis and trigger Knowledge Echo, while Final Calculation strengthens one area attack.
guide.starrail_sim.path.erudition.mechan:
R4 Knowledge Echo: after a hit, deal 15% of that hit's final damage to up to 1 other mob within 2.5 blocks; 1.2-second cooldown.
R5 upgrade: 3-block range, up to 2 mobs, for 20%.
R6 Weakness Deconstruction: hit 2 different mobs within 5 seconds to gain one +20% damage attack; it expires after 6 seconds.
R7 Final Calculation: 12-second cooldown; if at least 2 other mobs are within 3 blocks of the main target, deal 45% of final damage to mobs within 4 blocks.
guide.starrail_sim.path.harmony.core: Use food and resonance states to support combat, emphasizing buffs and cooperation.
guide.starrail_sim.path.harmony.goals: Eat 3 food items to trigger resonance and defeat 3 enemies while resonating.
guide.starrail_sim.path.harmony.practice: Trigger resonance and fight while the resonance state is active.
guide.starrail_sim.path.harmony.tips: Food builds Resonance, and continuing to fight while resonating completes the trial. Harmony focuses on sustained support: Afterglow strengthens follow-up attacks, Concert Echo adds value through attacks and kills, and Rank 7 Unified Resonance extends and improves the resonance state.
guide.starrail_sim.path.harmony.mechanic:
Trigger: eat food to gain Resonance; it lasts 15 seconds, or 20 seconds from R4.
R5 Afterglow: your next 3 attacks during Resonance each deal +5%.
R6 Concert Echo: a kill during Resonance restores 2.5% max health, at most once every 5 seconds.
R7 Unified Resonance: eating grants Absorption equal to 2.5% max health for 5 seconds; kills during Resonance add 3 seconds, up to 30 seconds total.
guide.starrail_sim.path.nihility.core: Apply Nihility Erosion, weaken enemies, and deal damage over time through negative effects.
guide.starrail_sim.path.nihility.goals: Apply Nihility Erosion 5 times and defeat 3 eroded enemies.
guide.starrail_sim.path.nihility.practic: Hit an unmarked hostile mob in melee or at range, then pass the Effect Hit check to record practice.
guide.starrail_sim.path.nihility.effect:
Cumulative stats (Effect Hit Rate/Attack Damage/Break Effect):
R4: 15%/10%/0%
R5: 20%/10%/0%
R6: 20%/15%/0%
R7: 30%/20%/10%
guide.starrail_sim.path.nihility.tips: Nihility first applies negative effects, then uses damage over time and echoes to gain an advantage. Higher Effect Hit Rate makes Erosion less likely to be blocked by enemy Effect Resistance. Erosion deals periodic damage, while higher-rank mechanics can spread it or trigger a burst when it ends.
guide.starrail_sim.path.nihility.mechani:
Trigger: melee or ranged hit on a hostile mob, followed by an Effect Hit check. On success, apply Weakness and Erosion: 1 damage per second, lasting 5 seconds (7 seconds from R4).
R5 Erosion Diffusion: on the first mark, attempt to spread it to 1 unmarked mob within 2.5 blocks.
R6 Pain Echo: Erosion damage increases to 1.5 per second.
R7 Nihility End: Erosion damage increases to 2 per second; killing your marked mob applies Erosion to living mobs within 3 blocks and deals 2 damage; no extra cooldown.
guide.starrail_sim.path.abundance.core: Practice Abundance through healing and repeated recovery, focusing on sustain and max health.
guide.starrail_sim.path.abundance.goals: Restore 10 health in total and complete 3 separate healing events.
guide.starrail_sim.path.abundance.practi: Restore health and complete separate healing events.
guide.starrail_sim.path.abundance.tips: Healing yourself or allies advances Abundance practice, and separate healing events count separately. Excess healing can become damage absorption; Rank 6 Renewal heals based on max health, while Rank 7 Mercy provides stronger emergency protection with a long cooldown.
guide.starrail_sim.path.abundance.mechan:
R4 Everflow: if your health is below 80% before healing, gain Regeneration for 3 seconds; 5-second cooldown.
R5 Dew: 50% of each overheal becomes Absorption, up to 4 points per event; no timer or cooldown.
R6 Renewal: if below 50% health before healing, gain Resistance for 2 seconds; 8-second cooldown.
R7 Mercy: lethal damage leaves you at 1 health, restores 20% max health, and grants Absorption equal to 5% max health; 60-second cooldown.
guide.starrail_sim.path.remembrance.core: Record combat memories and trigger echoes, emphasizing repeated hits and memory buildup.
guide.starrail_sim.path.remembrance.goal: Record 3 memories and hit the same enemy again within 8 seconds to trigger 2 echoes.
guide.starrail_sim.path.remembrance.prac: Record a target with a melee or ranged hit, then hit the same target again within the memory window to echo and gain practice.
guide.starrail_sim.path.remembrance.tips: Remembrance rewards repeatedly connecting with the same target: after recording a memory, hit that target again within the memory window to trigger an echo. The base window is 8 seconds and becomes 12 seconds at Rank 5; keep one target selected instead of switching constantly.
guide.starrail_sim.path.remembrance.mech:
Trigger: hit a mob to record it; hit the same target again within 8 seconds (12 seconds from R5) to echo and deal +1 flat damage (+2 from R4).
R5 Aftermemory: an echo empowers your next hit on that target within 5 seconds to ×1.1 damage.
R6 Memory Cycle: each echo starts a global 3-second interval during which no target can trigger another echo.
R7 Eternal Echo: after 3 echoes, the next available echo deals ×1.5 damage; 10-second cooldown.
guide.starrail_sim.path.elation.core: Build momentum through consecutive hits and Elation bursts, emphasizing combos and unexpected bursts.
guide.starrail_sim.path.elation.goals: Complete 8 consecutive hits and trigger 2 Elation bursts; do not wait more than 5 seconds between hits.
guide.starrail_sim.path.elation.practice: Melee and ranged hits both continue the combo; a gap over 5 seconds resets it (7 seconds from Rank 5).
guide.starrail_sim.path.elation.tips: Elation builds momentum through consecutive hits and triggers bursts when the rhythm reaches its conditions. Keep attacks close together, then use the burst to amplify damage. Higher ranks improve the combo window and the number or strength of burst triggers.
guide.starrail_sim.path.elation.mechanic:
Trigger: keep hits within 5 seconds (7 seconds from R5).
Every 3rd hit: add 2 flat damage (4 from R5); from R4, also roll one buff: Strength 5s, Regeneration 3s, Luck 10s, or Resistance 2s.
R6 Carnival Echo: your next 2 attacks after a burst each deal +10%.
R7 Ultimate Elation: every 6th combo hit can deal ×1.5 damage; 10-second cooldown, and roll the dice twice more.
guide.starrail_sim.help.damage: Damage numbers: normal damage is a white negative number; critical damage is a white negative number with an exclamation mark; damage over time also uses white numbers. Toughness damage is red, and a break hit is red with an exclamation mark.
guide.starrail_sim.help.toughness: Toughness: normal enemies have 10 base Toughness, elite enemies have 20, and bosses have 30. Each direct attack deals health damage and removes 1 Toughness at the same time, so health and Toughness are reduced together.
guide.starrail_sim.help.break: Break: when an enemy reaches zero Toughness, it enters the Broken state for 10 seconds. Toughness recovers from 0% to 100% over 20 seconds. Break hits deal additional break damage, and Break Effect improves the break payoff.
guide.starrail_sim.help.effect_hit: Effect Hit Rate: determines whether a negative effect can be applied. Nihility Erosion, damage over time, and higher-rank echoes make an Effect Hit check first; more Effect Hit Rate is more reliable against resistant enemies.
guide.starrail_sim.help.effect_resistanc: Effect Resistance: a target's ability to resist negative effects. It affects application, not an effect that has already succeeded; when the notification says an effect was resisted, that attempt did not apply.
guide.starrail_sim.help.knockback_resist: Knockback Resistance: reduces the distance or chance of being knocked back by attacks. It is separate from Armor, Armor Toughness, and Effect Resistance, and mainly affects positioning and combat rhythm.
guide.starrail_sim.help.attributes: Attribute details: click any attribute panel to inspect its base value, bonuses from paths or other sources, and final value. Percentage attributes are calculated from the corresponding base attribute.
guide.starrail_sim.help.practice_detail: Practice: each path counts actions that match its own theme. The Paths screen shows current practice and its target; the Nine Paths page explains the specific way to practice each path.
guide.starrail_sim.help.path_switch: Path switching: after the initial trial, you automatically enter the selected path. You can have only one current path; resetting it removes current path effects but keeps unlocked ranks and practice.
guide.starrail_sim.help.notifications: Path skill notices use their path color and appear above the player HUD; trial progress updates in real time. View practice totals in the Paths screen instead of expecting a notice for each point.

"Medeus, that was a godlike battle!"

tooltip.starrail_sim.where_dreams_belong: At the edge of the Asdana system, the Memory Zone surged like a stormy sea. She was a spark, ready to go out in the gale.
"For someone who cannot dream, entering the synesthesia dreamscape comes at a price comparable to 'death.'"
Her companion's worried voice still echoed in her ears. She took a deep breath and entered the Memory Zone.
As the vehicle sank quietly into the depths, fireflies escaped through the cracks, only to be swallowed by endless darkness.
"Why seek death?"
Deeper in the memory sea, the pale lights of Memory Zone creatures watched her with the indifference of distant eyes.
Dreams were still too far away for her. She stared into the endless dark as body and soul neared their breaking point beneath the weight of memoria.
Insects blotted out the sky as they broke through the front line. Wrapped in flame, she flew toward them; their ashes fell like snow over the black remains of the knights.
She had no time to hold a bouquet or offer a final tribute to each fallen Iron Cavalry soldier. Their lives bloomed and went out in an instant, like genetic code: numbers without names.
"Why live?"
In the deathly silence, she melted into the sea like a flame. Only a faint spark remained, moving onward toward the light, onward…
After who knew how long, she opened her eyes. The 'future' seemed like a pearl glowing through mist, and tears fell down her cheeks—
"To find a 'dream' of my own…"

tooltip.starrail_sim.price_of_peace.stor: "Lady Jade, without the supplies and donations you keep sending, the orphanage would..."

The children looked up and chattered about their recent stories, troubles, and dreams.

"Lady Jade, when I grow up, I will become someone like you!"
She gazed into the children's clear eyes and suddenly froze.
A child offered her an apple. "Yes! Someone who brings light and hope to others!"
Poverty, mistakes, sorrow, and suffering... She walked the galaxy, taking collateral and giving equal returns.
Life exists, strives, and dies because of desire; it is an irresistible law and life's inevitable nature.
A charitable hypocrite, a wicked merchant trading in souls... The galaxy gave her countless identities,
and only she understood the morality behind her actions.

tooltip.starrail_sim.ninja_scroll.story_: Somewhere in the Ninja Realm, a bleak haze covered the city.

Tempting whispers told him to abandon the dangerous subject. Why stake his whole life on it?
Cold threats warned that those who walked the edge of life and death would one day burn their lives away.
An angry voice accused the blasphemer and called for him to be cast into a cruel execution ground.

He closed his eyes and grasped the god's spark, letting pain drown his dying soul.
First the resolute eyes, then the beating heart, then the complete soul... He threw himself into the purest, fiercest refinement.

tooltip.starrail_sim.a_star_illuminates_: Looking back to childhood, she first heard an adventure story about the Trailblaze.
Her little heart raced at the mystery and vastness of the universe, so she picked up a brush and sketched her first vision of the cosmos.
"A comet ship, a silver rail, and a navigator..."
"Then maybe this is how Trailblaze could begin?"
But a curse delayed her steps, and a hospital bed trapped her youth.
In lonely hours, tall stacks of books, scattered engine diagrams, and empty paint bottles became her daily life.
The thin figure moved her brush, carefully outlining the dream she longed for.
"Perhaps I can seize more possibilities from the limited time I have."
"Even a dream deserves to be lit with color."
When the stars turned once more, between lowering and raising her eyes, she had set off on the journey toward the stars.
Carrying a shared wish with her friends, she became the person she had dreamed of becoming.
"The journey of the Trailblaze begins at this very moment."
The train crossed the cosmos, and the traces left by the navigator and companions traveling side by side formed a sturdy silver rail.
"Let us reach the future where the stars reside together!"

tooltip.starrail_sim.memory_of_me.story_: When the plum blossoms were about to fade, she liked to preserve that moment and keep it by her side.

Many years passed. Her reflection never changed, but on the scale of the cosmos, could she too remain vivid for only a fleeting instant?
‘If all things must pass away, what meaning is there in creation?’
No one knew how long the silence lasted. The wind stirred the falling blossoms, and the reflection answered as it always had.
‘So that one day, I will no longer keep the plum blossoms from falling.’

tooltip.starrail_sim.make_farewell_more_: Another farewell ceremony.
Treading upon shattered moonlight, the girl weaves a wreath of farewell by the riverside.
An ancient elegy freezes in the cold air; the quiet river flows toward a distant land of flowers.
A bloodstained book, a rusted sword, a handkerchief embroidered with verse... She accepts their keepsakes, and the stories of their lives.
“My eyes are like a lens, forever longing for the stars.”
An epitaph for a scholar who died too young.
“To life and death, a knight gives only a cold glance.”
The life's creed of an unnamed warrior.
“Life is but death, shining for a fleeting moment.”
The final line written with the life of a poet who sought eternity.
“Every flower once bloomed proudly...”
Accompanied by the river's lament, she offers poems, wreaths, and remembrance to the departed—
“If withering is inevitable, then at least let our farewell... be more beautiful.”

tooltip.starrail_sim.love_is_eternal.sto: The azure sky reflects a brilliant tomorrow.
One step, two steps… The path the girl has walked is so long; fortunately, the cherished stories were not forgotten by passing years.
Now, written together with everyone, the epic is complete and reaches its finale.
Stars, flowers, birds, a beautiful new world.
Veils, garlands, long skirts—the wind carries blessings.
Thirty million lifetimes of searching became one moment of happiness, enough to outweigh eternity's countless words.
The girl looked back and smiled.
“One stays in the past, one walks toward the future… but our hearts will never be apart♪”
She rose onto her toes and stepped into the past—
And memory became ripples from yesterday, flowing toward tomorrow.

tooltip.starrail_sim.starlight_for_long_: In the gaps between years, only her heartbeat still echoes.
As through countless nights before—keeping watch in the dark, then sleeping beneath it.
She cherishes the memories entrusted to her.
Starting from a blank beginning, the girl paints each stop she has visited in vivid colors: a cozy train, companions of every temperament, dazzling planets… like a dream too beautiful to leave.
“March 7th's real journey is only just beginning!”
The girl's declaration seems to ring in her ears.
She gazes toward the distant stars. A beam of light is about to arrive—
It is the train's light, like a shooting star.
“Good night, March… When you wake, may the journey of Trailblaze continue.”
The tide of memories rises. She keeps her wish deep inside, that tiny voice and light—
—she has never forgotten them.

tooltip.starrail_sim.may_rainbow_stay_in: “Emotions are like clouds, and we are the sky that carries them. When the sky is overcast, our moods become unpredictable.”
The doctor listened with care to each visitor's sorrow, offering gentle words of healing.
“Close your eyes and breathe slowly… Imagine yourself somewhere warm and soft…”
As if by magic, a seven-colored rainbow spilled beneath the winged beast's wings.
“A breeze will drift across the fields, carrying the scent of wildflowers. Moist clouds pass by, laden with sunlight…”
The visitor sank into a sweet dream, answered only by a soft, steady breath.
After seeing the last patient, the doctor gently closed the ward door.
The endless night still surged in the distance, and the ruins were wounds upon the earth.
“In the next life, may dawn shine upon everyone…”
Before setting out, she made a wish upon the sky—
“May the rainbow always remain in the sky.”

High above the city, a flamboyant girl bursts out of a portal.
Carriages and people stream by; the city is as noisy as ever.
“It sure is lively, but—”
A screen lights up before her, drawing people's joys and sorrows in sparkling motes.
“Even the NPCs' fatigue meters are almost maxed out…”
“This dungeon is so boring. I'm not playing it.”
Her fingers swipe across the screen, and the city lights flicker.
A cry rings out from a hidden corner, then echoes through the sky.
“Double every player's luck! Randomize bonus talents! Max out the rewards…”
“Game loaded! Let's take over the whole stage!”
The girl leaps down as familiar notification sounds ring in her ears.
Her time to play has begun.

A breeze stirs the white curtains, carrying the girl's thoughts with it.
She looks at the laughing crowd outside, her drawing pen unconsciously lingering in one spot.
“How many times have I sat here now…?”
A drifting petal brushes past her nose, as if in reply, as if in reminder.
A grand game, a once-in-a-lifetime meeting, days of blossoms and falling petals…
She recalls her story with this land, from a blank page to a world of color. Each time she sleeps, she looks forward to tomorrow.
“Oh, the manga updated! I'll go read it after I finish drawing the cuties…”
A notification arrives. The girl flicks her ears, and her still pen begins to dance again.
“My wish… Next flower season, I'll catch up on every top-rated new series!”

tooltip.starrail_sim.when_she_decides_to: Hold Shift to view Light Cone details
Once again, within the Realm of Delights, she watched fate weave like a shimmering web of beads, reflections overlapping, causes and effects without end.
“What do you see?”
Her master had once asked her that.
Some diviners saw their own insignificance and stopped believing that people could change their fate.
Others saw the great tides of the future and the optimal path of going with the flow.
Back then, the girl gazed into the Realm and saw endless darkness: a future already ordained.
She also saw the “starlight”—faint possibilities not yet swallowed by the gaze of the gods.
That wisp of starlight once slipped through her fingers, leaving Fanghu to an eternal night.
She had also seized fleeting variables and turned the fortunes of the Jade Abacus.
“A dead end is only dead because no one dares defy fate.”
She wanted her own answer, even if it meant stepping into the ill-starred place fate had chosen—
“What I saw is not what matters. What I can do is.”

When she grieves, her fans shed tears.
